title: Beautifull place and great massage
text:
The hammam experience was mostly pleasurable, even if some of the other
 Female guests had wandering hands. The mood was still very enjoyable, good Pools and the steamroom was very good. The massage was splendid.
One point of critism was that the language barrière was funny, the lady told me she was going to do me! 
Still a beautifull and relaxing place that is worth your time.
author: MarkvanVollenhoven

title: Amazing Alhambra
text: Great visit to an amazing historical site.  Beautiful hammam afterwards.  We upgraded the massage - definitely worth the extra.
author: S1622WUgregg

title: Amazing Alhambra
text:
Beautiful and historic.  Well deserving of its designation as a World Heritage site.

We upgraded the Hammam for a longer massage.  Definitely worth the extra charge (€13 per person) for the 30 minute massage.  Who gets a massage in 15 minutes?  :)
author: Greg_G

title: ALHAMBRA
text: The Alhambra is a MUST SEE!!!! The highlight of Granada, this moorish palace & military fortress is the pinnacle of moroccan architecture & design... WOW!!!!!!!!!!!
author: EthanHoff30

title: Don’t miss this tour!
text: Awesome tour.  Wonderful guide.  So many wonderful stories.  One small thing, I think showing an orientation map at beginning and referring back to it during tour would be helpful.  It’s so big, it’s easy to get lost.
author: Nicholas_L

title: An unforgettable visit with our excellent francophone guide Carlos
text: We had a great visit to this mythical place with our guide Carlos Serrano who was really friendly and who took the time to explain and answer all our questions. He is passionate and it shows!
author: Coco_Rocha

title: Excellent way to discover the Alhambra and its history
text: Perfect organization and competent guidance. Necessary to enjoy the grandeur of the Alhambra. I was afraid to find the classic money-eating organization that tops up the entrances offering little more, while I found a professional structure that really added value to the visit. The hammam in the afternoon a pleasant diversion, especially after the morning walk. Highly recommended.
author: scoutme

title: It was a very interesting and enlightening tour.  Gustavo grts 5 stars!
text: Being inside the Alhambra with a well-informed guide who spoke fluent English and willing to dialogue with the group.
author: Adelberto_B

title: Unforgettable, a unique experience!
text: Excellent guided tour. Alba, our guide explains in an exquisite way the history of the Alhambra and clarified all our doubts. Very friendly and professional, definitely made this experience unforgettable hehe even with 43 degrees!!!
author: CeciliaFlores09

title: Breathtakingly beautiful!
text:
This tour was incredible, from start to end! 
Our Alhambra tour guide, Carlos Serrano, was funny, personable and extremely knowledgable, making for a fantastic day out. 
The majestic Alhambra itself was nothing short of incredible and worth every moment spent. 
The evening Hammam was a feast for the senses and was the perfect way to end the day. 
I would highly recommend booking your Alhambra experience with GranaVision Excursions. Thank you Carlos for this memorable experience! This has been the highlight of my trip thus far :)
author: Kirshnee09
